prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1016; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate pain and restricted range of motion in the right shoulder at the time of initial evaluation. Physical examination demonstrated tenderness over the anterior shoulder, limited active abduction and forward flexion, and pain with resisted external rotation. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture; findings were consistent with a rotator cuff strain with associated soft tissue inflammation.

Over the course of care, the patient completed 16 visits. Treatment included a structured physical therapy program focusing on gradual restoration of range of motion, scapular stabilization, and progressive rotator cuff strengthening. Adjunctive care included ice and heat therapy, a short course of anti-inflammatory medication, and home exercise instruction. Pain levels and functional range of motion improved steadily across the treatment period.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient demonstrated near-full active range of motion with mild residual weakness on resisted testing and reported occasional discomfort with overhead activity. The patient has been advised to continue the home exercise program, avoid heavy overhead lifting until cleared, and return for reassessment if symptoms worsen.
